Let <MATH_0001> be a scheme. Let <MATH_0002> be a surjective proper morphism
of algebraic spaces over <MATH_0003>. Then <MATH_0004> is a ph covering.

Let <MATH_0001> be a morphism with <MATH_0002> affine.
By Chow's lemma (in the weak form given as
Cohomology of Spaces, Lemma <REF_0001>)
we see that there is a surjective proper morphism of schemes
<MATH_0003> which factors through <MATH_0004>.
Taking any finite affine open cover of <MATH_0005> we obtain a
standard ph covering of <MATH_0006> refining <MATH_0007>
as desired.
